name: Nine Circles

gist.Dante, the Wanderer of Hell: Once per turn deletes her current Area and brings one of her deleted Areas into play instead; or deletes a spell from hand to draw.
gist.Feral, the Fortress Breaker: Hits a target every time any Area is played, and can clear all Areas once per turn.
gist.Madame Guillotine, the Great Equalizer: During YOUR turn, each time you take an action or use a hero or Ability effect, she removes one Ability from one of your heroes until the end of the turn.
gist.The Seventh Circle of Hell: Area: at the end of each turn the turn player must hit one of their own targets. When it leaves play, she hits a target hard.
gist.The Fifth Circle of Hell: Area: when it leaves play, the next damage dealt to a single target this turn is doubled.
gist.The Sixth Circle of Hell: Area: when it leaves play, she takes control of one of your heroes for the turn.
gist.The Fourth Circle of Hell: Area: when it leaves play, she gains gold for every card in her deleted pile.
gist.The Second Circle of Hell: Area: when it leaves play, she takes back a deleted card.
gist.The Third Circle of Hell: Area: when deleted, digs six cards deep for another Area and plays it.
gist.The Eighth Circle of Hell: Area: either player may delete it to copy the other's card draw.
gist.Cataclysm: Free while an Area is out: hits everything and sends all Areas away, setting off hers.
gist.Reality Crack: Swaps all Areas for one from hand or deck.
gist.Burning Finger: Single-target burn; the usual hit to double with the Fifth Circle.
gist.Fireshield: Reaction: returns part of a hit to the attacker.
gist.Booby Trap: Face-down trap that punishes the attacker.

plan: Octavia does not keep an Area; she rotates them. Every Circle of Hell pays out when it leaves play, and Dante removes one and installs another each turn: the Seventh sits on the table during your turn so that you must hurt yourself, then leaves on hers for a heavy hit; the Fifth doubles the Magic Hammer that follows; the Sixth borrows your hero. Feral adds a hit for every Area played. Meanwhile Madame Guillotine takes an Ability off your heroes each time you do something on your own turn. The machine depends on Dante being free to act, and her three heroes have nothing but two traps and a Fireshield to protect them.

looks.early: A Circle of Hell in her Area zone, a different one each turn; a growing deleted pile set neatly aside.
looks.mid: The Seventh Circle out whenever it is your turn, Feral stinging on each rotation, one of your Abilities missing every time you act.
looks.late: A deleted pile like a second deck, a Circle leaving and a doubled Magic Hammer landing in the same breath.

opening.tell: Dante swaps her Area every turn and she controls no creatures.
opening.why: The rotation is one hero's once-per-turn effect; Dante has ordinary health and is worth every early point of damage, while removing a Circle yourself just hands her its parting effect.

midgame.tell: Each time you act on your own turn, Madame Guillotine lifts one Ability off your heroes until the turn ends.
midgame.why: Every extra action costs you a level for the turn, so do the one thing that needs your full Destruction Magic first and keep the turn short; a long setup turn strips your own caster.

crisis.tell: The Seventh Circle is out for your end of turn and she is holding the Fifth with a Magic Hammer.
crisis.why: A frozen Dante cannot rotate: the Seventh then stays for HER end of turn as well and the Fifth never arrives; Cataclysm or The Yeeting on the Circle only triggers its hit on you.

endgame.tell: Her heroes are low and her traps have been sprung; the Circles still turn.
endgame.why: She has no healing, and untargeted Storm ticks ignore what is left of her defences; this is a race you are already winning.
